quote.text: No hay quien pueda restituirte los años, y ninguno te restituirá a ti mismo: la edad proseguirá el camino que comenzó, sin volver atrás ni detenerse; no hará ruido ni te advertirá de su velocidad; pasará con silencio; no se prorrogará por mandado de los Reyes ni por el favor del pueblo, correrá desde el primer día como se le ordenó; en ninguna parte tomará posada ni se detendrá. ¿Qué se seguirá de esto? Que mientras tú estás ocupado huye aprisa la vida, llegando la muerte, para la cual, quieras o no quieras, es forzoso desocuparte.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that each day with your children is precious and fleeting; embrace every moment as an opportunity to nurture and guide them with love and wisdom.
    • Understand that time waits for no one—the silent passage of years calls for mindful engagement, where intentional actions leave a lasting legacy in your family’s life.
  • Leadership
    • Accept that time and change are beyond our control; as a leader, focus on inspiring your team to act in the present, valuing each decision as a stepping stone to lasting transformation.
    • Be resolute in your purpose, for every day is an opportunity to lead by example; do not postpone important decisions or visions, rather seize the moment to effect meaningful change.
  • Product Management
    • Realize that the market and consumer needs evolve silently and relentlessly; agile adaptation is key to ensuring that innovations are timely and impactful.
    • Invest your energies into iterative improvements and strategic planning today, for time lost in indecision may cost your product its relevance in a rapidly changing landscape.
